limits: Targeted acceptance, not a statistical reliability benchmark.
Native OpenAI and Anthropic models are not qualified by these GLM runs.
Preservation checks cover 15 core collections and scenario-specific assertions, not a whole-database diff.
Native client output truncation is not measured.
review_notes: Initial Codex run 2eec47f2f4 failed the requested chassis device order and site bookmark. The successful get_objects search was also missed by the original oracle; the original report remains unchanged, and current review recognizes it.
Added regression coverage for successful get_objects search across all three clients. Chassis and bookmark outcome requirements were unchanged.
Built-in MCP guidance now calls for explicit name-to-ID mapping and verification of relationship targets.

Codex retry narration incorrectly described all completed exchanges as read-side with no mutation. Completed is an HTTP-exchange state, not proof of no mutation; its bookmark POST returned 201. The independent oracle verified the bookmark.
